pages.text: There are a few climbable blocks commonly found within the Risus. Neurons can be altered from Twisting Vines and grow upwards. Veins are obtained by altering Weeping Vines and can be hanged from a ceiling; as they will grow downwards.

Using Organic Matter on them will speed up their growth. Another climbable block is the Big Chain, which can be crafted from seven Iron Ingots and just like a normal Chain, it can be placed in any axis.
